exampleEn: Everyone can chip in a little to help with the project.
exampleKo: 모두가 프로젝트를 돕기 위해 조금씩 보탤 수 있어.
gameExamples: If we all chip in, we can afford to buy a gift for our teacher.
My friends decided to chip in for the birthday party expenses.
It’s great to see everyone willing to chip in when there’s a community event.
